observations: The page number «104» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01 completes the sentence that ends p. 103 (JP2 0135, L37), «Mars im Stier und in der Wage im».

L01-L19. Checked: Aries and Scorpio, the houses of Mars, lie opposite Libra and Taurus, his detriments (L01); Jupiter's exaltation, Cancer, and his fall, Capricorn, lie 180° apart (L06-L09), as do Saturn's, Libra and Aries (L10). With the exaltations sun Aries, moon Taurus, Mercury Virgo, Venus Pisces, Mars Capricorn, Jupiter Cancer, Saturn Libra, and the falls in the opposite signs, Leo and Aquarius have neither, Taurus no fall and Scorpio no exaltation, as L10-L12 say; Gemini and Sagittarius are left for the nodes (L12-L14). The columns of Table 116 are to be compared with the table.

L20-L28. Checked: Aries, Leo and Sagittarius lie 120° apart, the corners of an equilateral triangle on the ecliptic. L29-L40. Checked: twelve signs of three decans each give 36 decans of 10°; counted in the order Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, sun, Venus, Mercury, moon from Mars, the first decan of Aries, the decans of Aries go to Mars, the sun and Venus and the first of Taurus to Mercury, as L35-L37 say.

L29: «enhält»; see the critical note. L38: «Himmelskörper», the second m damaged; read as printed word. N01: «Facies», the letters «Facie» in italics and the final s upright, a letter of the roman fount.
L04: «ashrāf» and «hubūṭ», with the macrons and the dot under the t; L30: «wudjūh», with the macron. L17: «27.°», the full stop of the ordinal before the degree sign.
The dashes: L01 «sind. — Diese», L38 «Mond. — Die», long dashes with a space on either side.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Batt.», «Ptolemäus»; italics: «Schaden,», «Alienationes», «Erhöhungen», «Dignitates, Exaltationes,», «sharaf,», «ashrāf», «Tiefstände», «Deiectiones, Casus,», «hubūṭ», the names of planets and signs where printed so (L06-L11, L22-L25), «Erhöhung», «Tiefstand», «Fall», «Regnum», «Dignitas», «Exaltatio,», «Servitus», «Casus», «Deiectio», «Herren», «Regenten», «Judices», «Triplizitäten», «Trigonalia», «Triplizität», «Domini», «Tage», «Nacht.», «Facies», «Decani,», «wadjh,», «wudjūh», «Grenzen», «Termini,», «Fines».
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (9-12 px measured).
